description: Codex: Orks (11e) IMPENDING KRUNCH (Blitz Brigade, 1 CP, your Charge phase) through the real unit_ended_charge_move window (design §3). Fixture ork11e_orks_active, moved straight to the Orks' Charge phase. Setup privileges: P1's detachment is switched to Blitz Brigade; Custodian Guard E is placed alone in the open and the Battlewagon (a WAGON) ~4" in front of it; P1 has 4 CP, P2 0 CP (no Fire Overwatch interlude). The charge is driven with the phase actions the charge UI sends: DECLARE_CHARGE, CHARGE_ROLL (seeded 2D6 = 5; the WAGON re-roll and Command Re-roll offers are declined) and the APPLY_CHARGE_MOVE the charge tools build (computed by the engine's charge-move solver, the same geometry the validator applies). When the charge move is applied the window opens for the charging player: the StratagemDialog offers IMPENDING KRUNCH on the Battlewagon with an enabled Use button. A real click on Use spends 1 CP and every enemy unit engaged with the Battlewagon (Custodian Guard E) makes a battle-shock roll with -1; a failed roll leaves it battle-shocked.
